note: Wires are the printed 23 unchanged: ER-30 (errata.pdf PDF p.3, 'page 11') corrects only the procedure, replacing 'by setting the pointer knob of the rotary switch at 1' with 'by pushing pushbutton 5', so errata_applied is empty and the script sets the first floor with a pb5 push instead of a dial grab. Each push is a 200 ms press then release; the page prints no hold time. Each floor claim is an until on the dial position, then a 5 s advance and an expect, so the assertion is where the dial rests, not a pass-through. Only the printed 'on' half of the floor map is asserted (light 5 on at the first floor, light 6 on at the second); the page does not state that the other floor light is off, so that and the relay indicator lights are left to Step 7. Book V printed p.26 (PDF p.32) reuses this circuit for manual control with feedback; its claims (pb6 moves the knob to 7 and light 6 comes on; at 1, light 5 comes on) are the same rest observables asserted here, and its uncorrected 'set the pointer knob at 1' start is not scripted. The dial's start position (c0) and its power-on run to c7 (relay 6 is released at power-on; the dial lands on c7 at 512.5 ms and rests there until the first pb5 push at 3 s) are construction state, not printed. 'Immediately' is not quantified, so no timing is asserted beyond the until window. Motor sweep (the four tools/motor-sweep.ts axes run on this fixture): FRAGILE on coast_udeg_stop_shorted, passing 0-16.875 deg and failing from 19.6875 deg (script[8]: the braked coast carries the wiper off pad 1); the profile value 5 deg passes and is not tuned. run_mrpm (25-60 rpm), contact_arc_udeg (fails only at 1.4-4.2 deg) and coast_udeg_drive_removed (0-45 deg) are ROBUST. Knife-edge trigger: minDecisionUa 8, relay 6's drop-out when relay 5 shorts its coil (5H/5G to 6E) on the pb6 push, is below min_decision_ua 14; minTickGap 9; all 6 bless robustness perturbations held, so the fixture is not marginal. Rotary geometry, run rate and coast remain profile fallbacks (O-R1, O-R3, O-R5).
